description: This file defines an interface for integration testing the ApplicationClientFactory within the Eclipse Hono project. It specifies methods for creating message senders and legacy command clients, and includes a static factory method for instantiation.

classes.name: IntegrationTestApplicationClientFactory
classes.description: An interface extending ApplicationClientFactory, providing methods to create message senders and legacy command clients for integration testing.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of IntegrationTestApplicationClientFactory with a given HonoConnection.

methods.name: createGenericMessageSender
methods.description: Creates a new MessageSender for a specified target address.

methods.name: createLegacyCommandClient
methods.description: Creates a legacy command client scoped to a specific tenant and device.
